_source: Measured from a live Celonis Process Explorer (academic cloud) rendering the same trace_data process, 2026-07-09. Layout units = CSS px at zoom 1 (extracted through the graph__canvas matrix, scale 0.38498).

arrow.scaleByWidth: 0.5 for thin (≤2px) up to 1 for thick

shapes.sameColumnVertical: single cubic, control points ~28%/61% of Δy: M224 52.37C224 67.99,224 89.65,224 108.5
shapes.neighborColumnDiagonal: single near-straight chord cubic (controls ~30%/66% ALONG the chord): M215.7 1380.38C248.7 1398.78,291.41 1422.59,326.17 1441.97
shapes.longLoopBack: arc out → degenerate-cubic straight vertical at fixed lane x → arc back in, entering the target at an angle: M91.23 1687.58C63.42 1668.33,30 1637.24,30 1599C30 989,30 989,30 989C30 957.49,50.48 929.05,71.8 908

layout.rowGapPx: ≈69 between node bottom and next top (row pitch ~112 for 43-tall nodes)
layout.columns: chain nodes near-centered with slight stagger; loop lanes at far x (30 / 376 in sample)
